content_sections.text: Ad-hoc appointment initially for 89/44 days, extendable by further 89/44 days with a one-day break Maximum tenure as Senior Resident is 03 years including previous tenure in any Govt. hospital/institute Reserved-category vacancies filled by General candidates are for 44 days or till a regular candidate joins Appointments from the relaxed-norm list are for one year only, not renewable 07 days' notice or seven days' salary required for resignation No claim over the post; services end when a regular appointee joins

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Senior Resident (Surgery), 3 Senior Resident (Medicine), 1 Senior Resident (Anesthesia).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 30 November 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on date of interview). Relaxation: PwD (Divyangjan) As per Govt. of India rules upon submission of Handicapped Certificate from the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Basic Pay in Level-11 as per 7th Pay Commission (Pay Level-11 of Rs.67700 ) for Senior Resident (Surgery), Basic Pay in Level-11 as per 7th Pay Commission (Pay Level-11 of Rs.67700 ) for Senior Resident (Medicine), Basic Pay in Level-11 as per 7th Pay Commission (Pay Level-11 of Rs.67700 ) for Senior Resident (Anesthesia).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with PG Degree/ Diploma or any other equivalent qualification in the concerned specialty recognized by Medical Council of India; registered with Delhi Medical Council (only qualification incorporated in DMC will be considered); must not have completed three years Senior Residency. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council or have applied for DMC registration on or before the date of interview. Must not have completed three years Senior Residency. Private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited; cannot work as SR in another hospital simultaneously. May be required to perform duties in Accident & Emergency Department as per patient care requirements.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Walk-in interview held till suitable candidates are selected. Separate merit list for relaxed-norm candidates, used only after the fresh candidates' list is exhausted.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ad-hoc appointment initially for 89/44 days, extendable by further 89/44 days with a one-day break. Maximum tenure as Senior Resident is 03 years including previous tenure in any Govt. hospital/institute. Reserved-category vacancies filled by General candidates are for 44 days or till a regular candidate joins.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ambedkar Nagar Hospital, Dakshinpuri, New Delhi.
